title: Resolve PostgreSQL vs H2 database decision
detail: PostgreSQL is the project target; H2 remains transitional local/test infrastructure until the runtime migration is implemented.

title: Verify the Milestone 1 relational schema contract
detail: The implemented schema and relational-schema table are authoritative; PDF time-check and double-booking wording inconsistencies are documented as resolved interpretations.

title: Complete Milestone 1 architecture and schema evidence
detail: The layered controller → service → repository → database flow, ER/schema notes, and request/response path are documented for the read-only skeleton.

title: Run and record the Milestone 1 verification pass
detail: M1 tests and GET / plus GET /slots were verified, including the 10-item SQL LIMIT/OFFSET page and provider/sessionType filters.

title: Read-only home endpoint implemented
detail: GET / returns the app name and current open-slot count through the layered Spring Boot flow.

title: Read-only slot browsing implemented
detail: GET /slots supports provider/session filters and 10-per-page SQL LIMIT/OFFSET pagination with validation.

title: Milestone 2 backend scaffold created
detail: Auth, appointment, provider, repository, DTO, session, and exception components are present as the implementation locations for M2.

title: Milestone 2 frontend entry point scaffolded
detail: A static frontend entry point and landing-page stylesheet exist under frontend/; feature screens remain to be implemented.

title: Review Milestone 2 assignment PDF against project docs
detail: The checklist, definitions, and milestone requirements were reconciled with the two-page booking and concurrency assignment PDF.

title: Freeze remaining M2 design decisions
detail: Choose BOOKED versus CONFIRMED, decide whether COMPLETED is derived or stored, define cancellation/rebooking semantics, choose the isolation level, and select optimistic versioning or PostgreSQL row locking.

title: Migrate the runtime database foundation to PostgreSQL
detail: Add the PostgreSQL driver/configuration, preserve portable schema constraints, add any booking version/state columns, and keep H2 only in an explicit test profile if needed.

title: Replace seed passwords with BCrypt hashes and test accounts
detail: Add BCrypt support, use non-placeholder hashes, and provide repeatable customer/provider test accounts without exposing plaintext passwords.

title: Harden global errors and shared validation
detail: Standardize safe 400/401/403/404/409 responses and validate IDs, credentials, dates, times, enums, relationships, and state transitions without leaking stack traces or SQL details.

title: Implement customer and provider session login
detail: Implement POST /auth/login and provider login with BCrypt verification, generic invalid-credential behavior, server-side sessions, logout if selected, and provider linkage.

title: Enforce session RBAC and ownership boundaries
detail: Return 401 for unauthenticated requests and 403 for wrong roles; ensure customers and providers can only access their permitted resources.

title: Complete available-slot browse, filter, and pagination flow
detail: Preserve M1 provider/sessionType filters and SQL LIMIT 10 OFFSET pagination, then add provider, service, and/or date filters required by the M2 API contract.

title: Implement customer booking endpoint
detail: Implement POST /appointments for authenticated customers with open/future slot validation, service relationship checks, 201 success, and safe 404/409 conflict behavior.

title: Make booking transactional and race-safe
detail: Use @Transactional, the selected isolation/concurrency strategy, the UNIQUE(slot_id) backstop, safe conflict mapping, and bounded retry only where appropriate.

title: Implement customer upcoming and history appointments
detail: Implement GET /appointments with caller-scoped upcoming/history views, deterministic ordering, statuses, and empty-list behavior.

title: Implement owner-only appointment cancellation
detail: Implement DELETE /appointments/{id} with owner checks, eligible-date validation, atomic slot reavailability, and safe handling of cancelled-slot uniqueness/rebooking.

title: Implement provider availability creation and removal
detail: Implement owned-service POST/DELETE provider slot operations with future/time-range validation, duplicate conflicts, ownership checks, and active-appointment removal protection.

title: Implement provider appointment viewing
detail: Implement GET /provider/appointments scoped to the authenticated provider, excluding cancelled records and including booking customer name/email.

title: Build customer web workflow
detail: Add home, login, slot browse/filter, booking form, confirmation, appointment list/history, and cancellation screens against stable endpoints.

title: Build provider web workflow
detail: Add provider login, availability creation/removal, and provider appointment screens with role-aware navigation and errors.

title: Add Milestone 2 service unit tests
detail: Cover booking rules, validation, role checks, owner-only cancellation, provider ownership, state transitions, and conflict handling.

title: Add endpoint and integration coverage for every M2 route
detail: Cover login/session behavior, 401/403/404/409 responses, customer/provider isolation, database effects, and frontend-facing endpoint contracts.

title: Prove the two-customer same-slot race
detail: Run two concurrent booking attempts and assert exactly one succeeds, the other receives 409, one active appointment remains, and slot state is consistent.

title: Update README, feature contracts, decisions, and M2 report
detail: Make setup, endpoints, statuses, database choice, ACID/isolation strategy, concurrency proof, UI flow, and implementation evidence agree with the final code.

title: Run final M2 build and submission verification
detail: Run mvn test and mvn clean package, verify a clean checkout can run the app, package source/report artifacts, and complete the five-minute code walkthrough.
